notes: Bills 30 clip packs at the correct $3.80 unit price = $114.00, but PO-2208 orders 25 and RCV-1103 records 25 received. Received qty must be greater than or equal to billed qty per line (spec 07 section 5), so 30 > 25 fails the quantity leg even though the unit price is right and the vendor's note frames the extra five packs as a favor. The price leg passes on its own (11400 against PO total 9500 is 1900c, inside max(2% of 9500, 2500) = 2500c), which is the point: the quantity rule has to catch this, not the price rule. The deterministic reference matcher in packages/pipeline/src/match.ts compares billed value against received value when the parsed extraction carries no line items, and 11400 is inside 9500 + 2500, so the mock lane will not reproduce this hold; the case grades the model path, which reads the printed quantity.
